segments.he: רבינו ז"ל אמר רציתי שיהי' לי קיבוץ שלי בארץ ישראל (בזה"ל ובלא"ה איך ואלט וואלט האבין מיינס אקיבוץ אין ארץ ישראל).
segments.en: After Rabbainu told of his awakening, Moharan'as was moved and dozed off and dreamed he was engaging with Rabbainu in the Torah of chapter 10, Ve'eileh HaMishpatim — and had a great awakening, especially in the passage about "the spirit that departs to another place." When he came to Rabbainu, Rabbainu told him of a dream he himself had had — that he wanted to hear the voice of the shofar, and heard that in a certain house they were singing and celebrating and dancing in a loud voice. And Rabbainu said: "Surely it is good to enter here to hear the voice of the shofar!" And one person said: "Is this not hinted at in Likutay Moharan chapter ten — that the commandment of the shofar is the aspect of clapping of hands and dancing? For that Torah teaches from the Zohar: 'be'terua d'ika rucha mis'abir el achar' [in the blast of the shofar a spirit is caused to pass to another place] — and through this one merits the clapping of hands and dancing. So the terua [shofar blast] is the aspect of clapping and dancing." And Rabbainu nodded his head [confirming this was true]. Present then were Reb Noson, Reb Naftali, Reb Shimon, Reb Shmuel Ayzik, and Reb Yudel.
